nom: FARMACY Green Clean Gentle Creamy Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive or reactive report the cleanser removes makeup without stinging, tightness, or new irritation, and several call it one of the few cleansers their reactive skin tolerates.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report no tight or stripped feeling after rinsing and describe the finish as hydrated and comforted, though one dry-skin reviewer notes it doesn't remove sunscreen very well.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination (including combination-dry and combination-acne-prone) skin report it cleanses effectively while still feeling nourishing, with one preferring it for morning use over gel cleansers.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers concerned about dryness consistently report the cleanser does not leave a tight or stripped feeling and describe skin as soft, hydrated, and nourished after rinsing; one reviewer notes it does not remove sunscreen as thoroughly, which she frames as a trade-off for gentleness.
concerns.redness: A few reviewers report reduced redness and calmer-looking skin after repeated use, with one noting no redness or irritation at all after switching to this cleanser.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers focused on barrier repair report the cleanser feels balancing and non-stripping, with one specifically crediting it for supporting her skin barrier while cleansing.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report no new breakouts and describe skin as calmer or clearer; no reviewer describes new or worsening blemishes from this product.

aspects.libelle: No tightness or stripped feeling after rinse
Struggles to fully remove sunscreen or eye makeup
Product lasts long, small amount needed
Higher price point than typical cleansers

extraits.titre: I LOVE this cleanser. A new holy grail for me.
extraits.texte: For some reason, the last few years, my skin has become incredibly sensitive and reactive. After eliminating pretty much everything but cleanser/moisturizer/spf in the day, I'd been using an oil cleanser at night that I didn't love and I think caused congestion, because the many others marketed as gentle cleansers I tried were irritating my skin visibly way more. I quite literally almost stumbled into this product on the end-cap in an Ulta recently, and to the employee that steered me to decide on this one and not another I was considering, I hope your pillow is always cold and your phone is never low battery and the stoplight always stays green for you. I LOVE this product because it cleans my skin, doesn't strip or feel tight, doesn't irritate my skin, doesn't break me out, and is cruelty-free. I love this enough that I will absolutely repurchase despite it being more money than I would like to be spending on a face wash. That said, I've been using just a pea sized amount at night and it's been plenty so I think a bottle will last me a while.

I have super sensitive skin that has been highly reactive to everything I've used lately. This cleanser has been one of the only things I can use that settles my skin down, cleans very effectively, and leaves my skin soft. The formula is this beautiful, soft creamy texture with gentle ingredients that delicately lather. I have zero irritation and all of my makeup is gone. I wear a full beat so that speaks volumes of its cleansing power. Very impressed and will purchase going forward. Gifted by Farmacy

I absolutely love Farmacy products and have tried many. My skin is dry, sensitive, and acne prone. I'm always looking for products that are fragrance free and was so excited to try this one! As suggested on the product, I started with the cleansing balm and finished with this. It makes my skin feel SO clean and hydrated! My sensitive skin loves it. It removes all of my makeup and doesn't cause my skin to react in any way but positive. Love it! Gifted by farmacybeauty.

It's super gentle yet effective, it doesn't strip my skin at all and leaves it feeling soft, calm, and refreshed. The creamy texture is so soothing, and I love that it's fragrance free, which makes it perfect for my sensitive, dry prone skin. I noticed reduced redness and irritation after just a few uses. It pairs beautifully with the Green Clean balm for a double cleanse that's luxurious and non irritating. Gifted by Farmacy Beauty

Like all the plant based ingredients that this gentle yet effective cleanser brings to my skincare routine. I do prefer more of a foam to my cleansers to feel the cleanest but I did enjoy it. Recyclable packaging makes it a stand out product along with this cleansers ability to get even stubborn sunscreen off at the end of the day. Gifted by farmacybeauty

I have sensitive skin that also breaks out easily . I love that this cleanser cleans my face really well . It doesn't make my skin feel tight or dry . I also like that while it's gentle it doesn't remove my sunscreen well . I was gifted by farmacy beauty

This is my all time favorite clean skincare brand. This cleanser is great and made with clean ingredients. I use this and the cleansing balm to double cleanse. This cleanser is great for my combination acne prone skin. Complimentary from farmacybeauty
